note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 28 November 2026, RealHunt lists 18 homes for sale in Canada, each one checked by a person.
In Canada, the median asking price of those 18 homes is €99,500 (€930 per m², from the 18 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €54,029 and the most expensive €190,700.
Taxes and fees add about 1.5–4% to the price of a home in Canada (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: Buyers usually pay provincial land transfer tax on a sliding scale (Ontario: 0.5% up to $55,000 and 1% from $55,000 to $250,000), legal fees of about $500 to $1,500, title insurance of about $250 and an inspection of $300 to $1,000, while the seller usually pays the agents; foreign buyers also pay Ontario's 25% non-resident speculation tax anywhere in Ontario and British Columbia's 20% additional tax in Metro Vancouver and four other regions.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Mostly not for now: a federal ban stops non-Canadians from buying homes in cities and larger towns until January 1, 2027, with exceptions such as work permit holders and spouses of citizens or permanent residents. The ban does not cover rural areas and small towns, and the government has said it does not plan simply to extend it, but a replacement is being studied.
buying.annual_property_tax: Property tax is set by each city as a share of assessed value, from about 0.3% in Vancouver to 2.12% in Saint John in 2026.
buying.rental_income_tax: Non-residents have 25% of gross rent withheld, but they can file a Section 216 return to pay tax on net rent instead, and Form NR6 lets the agent withhold on net rent.

homes.title: Move-in ready 4-bedroom house with garage and land in Belleterre, Témiscamingue, Quebec
homes.title_es: Casa de 4 dormitorios lista para entrar con garaje y terreno en Belleterre, Témiscamingue, Quebec
homes.summary: This move-in ready house in the village of Belleterre is ready for new owners to move in now. It has 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, with 174 m2 of living space. A garage and a parking space in the garage are included, and the property sits on a plot of land. The garage sits on a concrete slab and the home is available now. Asking €54,029, about €311/m².

homes.title: Big family house with sea views over the Strait of Canso
homes.title_es: Casa familiar grande con vistas al mar sobre el estrecho de Canso
homes.summary: A well-kept 1949 house in Mulgrave, Nova Scotia, with three bedrooms, 1.5 baths and beautiful views over the Strait of Canso. Updated kitchen, 200-amp electrics and new plumbing; about 215 m² in total. Asking price CAD 144,500. Canada's ban on foreign buyers applies in cities and towns of 10,000+ people until 1 January 2027; ask the agent whether it applies here.

homes.title: Updated five-bedroom house with a bathroom for every bedroom in Twillingate, Newfoundland
homes.title_es: Casa actualizada de cinco dormitorios con cuarto de baño para cada dormitorio en Twillingate, Terranova
homes.summary: Asking C$194,000 (about €123,400), under €610 per m². A roomy 203 m² house in the outport town of Twillingate, in Newfoundland's Iceberg Alley, known for iceberg and whale watching. It has had major renovations: complete rewiring with 200-amp service, electric heat throughout, a mini-split heat pump and an updated kitchen with new white cabinets. There are five bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom, plus a half bath, a living room and two dining areas. It was run as a bed and breakfast and is sold fully furnished. Outside are a lawn, a 14 x 20 ft storage shed and a traditional root cellar. Property tax C$1,200 a year.

homes.title: Freshly painted three-bedroom house with ocean views in Hillsburn, Nova Scotia
homes.title_es: Casa de tres dormitorios recién pintada con vistas al océano en Hillsburn, Nueva Escocia
homes.summary: Asking C$194,900 (about €124,000) for a three-bedroom house of about 106 m² on a hillside plot in Hillsburn, a shore village on the Bay of Fundy about 10 minutes from Annapolis Royal. The aerial photos show the sea just below. It is move-in ready, with a freshly painted exterior and new windows. The main floor has a large country kitchen with an island, a dining room, a living room with a pellet stove and a sea view, and a big bathroom with soaker tub and walk-in shower. Upstairs are the three bedrooms and a storage room. Outside are raised garden beds, a shed, a deck and a viewing platform.

homes.title: Renovated 3-bedroom house with open plan kitchen and land in Saint-Fabien, Quebec
homes.title_es: Casa renovada de 3 dormitorios con cocina abierta y terreno en Saint-Fabien, Quebec
homes.summary: This renovated house has had several recent renovations, including the kitchen and ground-floor flooring. It offers 163 m2 of living area over 6 rooms, with 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and an open plan equipped kitchen. The plot covers 5,296 sq ft of land, and the home has air conditioning. A new central heat pump provides heating, and the home includes a central vacuum, a refrigerator, a dishwasher, a stove and a washer and dryer. Asking €127,654, about €783/m².

homes.title: Character 1888 house with harbour views and a koi pond garden in Pictou, Nova Scotia
homes.title_es: Casa de carácter de 1888 con vistas al puerto y jardín con estanque de carpas en Pictou, Nueva Escocia
homes.summary: Asking C$249,900 (about €159,000) for a white wooden house of about 171 m², built in 1888 in the preserved old town of Pictou, with views over the harbour and a short walk to downtown. The big costs are done: a newer metal roof, a propane furnace and some new plumbing. Inside are tall windows, wood floors, a fireplace, original crown mouldings and a curved staircase, with three bedrooms and one and a half bathrooms. The front veranda faces the street, and the back garden has a koi pond and a large barn. The kitchen is older but clean.

homes.title: Acadian coast house with 4 bedrooms and a new bathroom
homes.title_es: Casa en la costa acadiana con 4 dormitorios y baño nuevo
homes.summary: A 1.5-storey house of about 107 m² in Grande-Anse on New Brunswick's Acadian coast, by the Bay of Chaleur. The main floor has been updated, with a bright living room, a big kitchen and a fully renovated bathroom; two of the four bedrooms keep their original character upstairs. Asking price CAD 159,000. Canada's ban on foreign buyers applies in cities and towns of 10,000+ people until 1 January 2027; ask the agent whether it applies here.

homes.title: Cottage-style house with a new kitchen near the waterfront in Pictou, Nova Scotia
homes.title_es: Casa de estilo cottage con cocina nueva cerca de la orilla en Pictou, Nueva Escocia
homes.summary: Asking C$199,900 (about €127,100) for a white cottage-style house of about 132 m² in the heart of Pictou, a historic harbour town on the Northumberland Strait. The kitchen is brand new, with white units, wood counters and an island, and opens to a bright dining room with exposed beams. There is a large bathroom with laundry on the ground floor, and three bedrooms plus an office upstairs. The fenced back garden has a big new deck, a shed and a wired workshop. Downtown shops, cafes, the marina and the waterfront are a few steps away.

homes.title: Updated character house with a wood stove and workshop in Liverpool, Nova Scotia
homes.title_es: Casa de carácter actualizada con estufa de leña y taller en Liverpool, Nueva Escocia
homes.summary: Asking C$220,000 (about €140,000) for a 1935 house of about 155 m², a few minutes from downtown Liverpool, a harbour town on Nova Scotia's South Shore about 90 minutes from Halifax. Much of the work is done: refinished original wood floors, a renovated kitchen with custom cabinets, wooden worktops and a cast-iron farmhouse sink, replastered and painted walls, updated wiring and plumbing, new gutters and a certified wood stove in the newly insulated living room. There is a bathroom with shower downstairs, a new half bath upstairs and a flexible two-plus-one bedroom layout. Outside are a large workshop and a stocked woodshed.

homes.title: Four-bed heritage house with tin ceilings and flower gardens in downtown Summerside
homes.title_es: Casa histórica de cuatro dormitorios con techos de hojalata y jardines de flores en el centro de Summerside
homes.summary: Asking C$299,900 (about €190,700). A historic house of 156 m² in Summerside's Downtown Heritage District, close to the shops, restaurants and waterfront. It keeps its hardwood and softwood floors, Douglas fir trim, decorative tin ceilings and built-in cabinets. The main floor has a living room with a propane stove, a formal dining room, a large eat-in kitchen, laundry, two bedrooms and a family room with a cathedral ceiling, a pellet stove and garden doors to the rear deck. Upstairs are two more bedrooms and a bathroom with a claw-foot tub. Mature trees and flower gardens surround it. Property tax C$2,218 a year.

homes.title: Four-bedroom house on about five acres in Saint Andrews, New Brunswick
homes.title_es: Casa de cuatro dormitorios en aproximadamente cinco acres en Saint Andrews, Nuevo Brunswick
homes.summary: Asking C$299,900 (about €190,700) for a white house of about 150 m² on roughly five acres at the edge of Saint Andrews, a well-known coastal resort town in New Brunswick. It has four bedrooms and two full bathrooms, two bedrooms on the main level and two below, a bright living room with wood floors, a kitchen with wood cabinets and large decks. The land is mostly lawn and trees, with a storage shed, and the aerial photos show the bay in the distance. Downtown shops, restaurants and the waterfront are minutes away. Yearly property tax C$3,679.
